resources.string: Live AI audio only happens when a call reaches Sparta\'s telephony number. Call forwarding is set up with your mobile carrier, not by this app: the button below only opens your dialer with the code filled in. You review it and press call yourself.
When my phone is off or has no signal
To turn this off later dial %1$s. To clear all forwarding dial %2$s.

These are standard GSM codes, but carriers differ: some ignore them, some charge for forwarded calls, and Android cannot confirm that forwarding is active. Check with your carrier. This app cannot verify the result.
The backend has not provided a valid forwarding number, so there is nothing to set up.
